data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for integrating the HyperPay payment gateway on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It enables seamless integration with the HyperPay payment gateway, supporting both ReadyUI and CustomUI with payment methods like VISA, MasterCard, MADA, STC, and Apple Pay.
use_when: You need to integrate HyperPay payment gateway in a Flutter mobile app.
You require support for ReadyUI and CustomUI flows including Apple Pay and MADA.
avoid_when: You are using a payment gateway other than HyperPay, such as Stripe or Adyen.
strengths: Supports multiple payment brands including VISA, MasterCard, MADA, STC, and Apple Pay.
Provides both ReadyUI and CustomUI implementations.
Actively updated with native SDK versions.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration on both Android (build.gradle, AndroidManifest.xml) and iOS (Podfile, URL schemes).
STC CustomUI for iOS is not currently supported.
data.setup_notes: Requires native setup steps in Android (adding specific aar dependencies, setting minSdkVersion to 21, and configuring intent filters) and iOS (modifying Podfile to include the hyperpay_sdk git repo and configuring static framework bindings and URL schemes).

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Stripe instead of HyperPay for payment processing.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Adyen as your payment gateway instead of HyperPay.
